name: koishi-plugin-group-summary
description: Periodically publish AI-generated group chat topics.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && tailwindcss -i site/app.css -o dist/app.css --minify && esbuild site/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/app.js && cp site/index.html site/_headers dist/
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name group-summary --branch main
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --composite false && tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib es2022,dom,dom.iterable site/app.ts

description.zh: 周期性生成并发布群聊话题摘要
